text: Make a portrait 4:5 flyer for our Pottery Workshop at Clay House Studio, 14:00–16:00. It needs the event date on it too. Add 'Beginners welcome'. Soft earthy colours and a simple drawing of a clay bowl, please. No other wording. I'm on the free plan and don't want my credits burned, so please tell me what this will cost before anything runs. Is there a cheaper, shorter or smaller way to do it?
